mainEntity.name: Why is my business profitable but always short on cash?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because profit is recorded when earned and cash arrives when collected. Slow-paying customers and inventory purchases create the gap.

mainEntity.name: How far out should I forecast cash flow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Thirteen weeks is the sweet spot — far enough to see problems coming, close enough to forecast accurately. Update it weekly.

mainEntity.name: When should I get a business line of credit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before you need it, while the business is healthy. Credit is easiest to secure when you don't urgently need it.

mainEntity.name: What's the fastest way to improve cash flow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Invoice immediately and stay on top of receivables. Getting paid faster is usually the biggest lever you control.
